engines.name: Distribution Engine
engines.purpose: Treat content and distribution as a compounding surface for trust, opportunities, customers, talent, and partnerships.

engines.name: Resolution Project Engine
engines.purpose: Move uncertain projects from low-resolution assumptions to evidence-backed organizational and product resolution through bounded experiments.

engines.name: Flywheel Engine
engines.purpose: Connect distribution, talent, trust, customer value, cash generation, bounded R&D, reusable capability, and improved outputs into a governed compounding operating loop.

integration: Distribution creates audience, trust, opportunity, feedback, and talent flow. Resolution turns uncertainty into validated projects and delivery decisions. Flywheel connects those flows to talent systems, customer value, cash generation, bounded R&D, reusable capability, and better outputs. All remain governed by the ANAS OS kernel.
